pairedNativeFields.method: Fresh read-only static arm64 disassembly and manual control/data-flow reconstruction. No Media Composer launch, private Avid execution, database writes or Bella implementation.
conclusions: Media Composer writes separate Unicode and legacy representations for these paired fields. It does not give every MDB field two representations.
The current Mac legacy writer uses the system codec and allows question-mark substitution for unrepresentable Unicode. Its legacy copy can be lossy while its UTF-8 copy remains complete.
Named UTF-8 properties contain plain UTF-8 plus a NUL terminator. They do not use PMR counted-string framing or the two-byte markers of known Unicode BOB attributes.

The native bin/directory/main-file-path readers prefer nonempty Unicode and can use the separate legacy representation if Unicode is absent or empty. Conversion failure enters a raised-error path before those local fallback checks.
LastKnownVolume differs: its writer omits an empty Unicode tag, but its reader does not test that a present Unicode tag is nonempty before replacing the earlier legacy value.

Bella can deliberately use a simpler per-field usable UTF-8 then separate MacRoman fallback policy, including unreadable Unicode. That is a policy choice, not exact replication of every Media Composer error path.
Path representations also differ in syntax and volume prefixes. Fallback includes the appropriate path reconstruction, not only a codec change.

bellaAssessment.proposedRule: For each semantic field and owner, prefer a validated, explicitly UTF-8 representation. If absent or unusable, try the separately recorded legacy representation using the agreed MacRoman policy. If neither works, leave the value unavailable.
qualifications: Do not reinterpret broken UTF-8 payload bytes as MacRoman.
A fallback must describe the same field and owner. An unrelated Name attribute is not a replacement.
A legacy fallback can legitimately contain question marks introduced by the native writer.
Interpret locator path syntax separately from text decoding.
This does not establish legacy encoding for every historical or Windows producer.
PMR whole-set selection remains unchanged; MDB structural damage and required-reference policy remain separate.

compatibleAdd.name: CoreAttrList::AddUTF8StringCompatible

proposedBellaRule.status: Approved requirement on 2026-10-18; not implemented. The key name is retained from the research proposal.
proposedBellaRule.rule: For each known field and correct owner, prefer a complete explicitly identified UTF8 value with valid expected layout and strict Unicode decoding; otherwise use a separate readable legacy counterpart as MacRoman, if one exists. Decode legacy-only values directly as MacRoman. Leave unavailable when no usable representation remains.
qualifications: Do not retry malformed UTF8 bytes as MacRoman.
Known Kind4 Unicode text uses two zero markers then UTF8 thenNUL; arbitrary Kind4 BOB is not text.
Normal attributes have one value pername; Kind2 and Kind4 replace one another. Project is not automatically a paired property.
ClipName legacy component route has no established Unicode backup; a preserved Name attribute on a different owner is not such a backup.
Path syntax and field role must be interpreted separately from codec; healthy paired path strings need not match.
DamagedUnicode to separatelegacy fallback differs from native helper error behavior.
Native Project _PJ to PROJNAME is absent-only; extending it to blank/damaged keys is a separate, unapproved choice.
Native legacy substitution can lose characters permanently; encoding validity does not prove intended content.
Historical terminator acceptance, MDB structural damage policy, source precedence, header reads and scheduling remain separate.
PMR whole-set policy remains unchanged; Windows producer encoding remains deferred.

Typed attribute UTF8 validation is not uniform in native APIs; FindUTF8StringAsUTF16 reaches UnicodeString::fromUTF8 through UTF8ToUnicodeString, unlike the paired-property strict converter. No claim all malformed Project Kind4 values throw.

userDecision.approved: Explicitly identified usable UTF8 per field/owner, otherwise a separate readable legacy counterpart as MacRoman where available; legacy-only text direct MacRoman, no reinterpretation of broken UTF8 bytes.
userDecision.deliberateRecovery: User explicitly confirmed recovery using the separate legacy value even where native paired-property readers raise an error.
